snippet.title: Voxmons – Hatch, Collect & Battle Voxel Monsters | Steam Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Hatch eggs, collect voxel creatures and lead them into battle.

In Voxmons, every creature you hatch can join your squad. They orbit you in living rings, pick their own targets and fight for you while you explore four worlds of floating islands: sunny Forest, frozen Snow, Lava depths and the Undead Graveyard.

🥚 187 Voxmons across seven rarities, from Commons to ultra-rare Ancients
⚔️ Your squad fights on its own: you explore, they clear the way
🏝️ 36 floating islands linked by bridges and sealed portals
🌗 A full day–night cycle and boss fights at the end of every world
💸 Free to play: no ads, nothing to buy

Coming to Steam Early Access on November 12, 2026.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5468140/
💬 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/UGC9Gbuts9
